posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: As long as the prices are kept low by rumours, inconsistencies, management behaviour, some repeated expectation and disappointment on dividends, etc., insiders have every incentive to increase their stake at lower prices, given the potentially very high value of the company if the project is executed. The only barriers to dilution are VWAP (remaining low due to low prices) for a specified period, the valuation report, and the maximum of two.
